label: the scorch crew
note: Issue #882: the red world's race ladder (rung 1 of 3), the scorch crew. They race out of their camp outside the start line (the landmark racers_camp_red_scorch), on Scorch Loop. Same shape as basin.json (read its note); their own rung order on this world: `after` is the red crew you must beat first. The first red crew races anyone.

lines.slips_accept: Pink slips? Ha. Winner drives home in both.
lines.no_room: Where would you even park it? Your row's full.
lines.slips_not_yours: Bet a ride that isn't yours yet? Shake whoever owns it first, then we talk slips.

challenge: New out here? The red sand eats speeders. Two laps of the Scorch Loop, straight through the hill.
Mines on the line, nothing fancier. Still want in?
